question: √2 + √3 is classified as:
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ The sum of two **irrational numbers** (√a + √b) where a and b are not perfect squares is always **irrational**. Since 2 and 3 are **prime numbers**, √2 and √3 are both irrational. The sum of two distinct surds cannot be expressed as a simple fraction p/q. **∴ The correct answer is Irrational.**
